turns.content: On 2025-12-16, the day after my birthday, my boss's boss Butch emailed that my calendar looked empty and wanted to make sure I was getting things done and making the most of my time. It stressed me out because I felt like my job was in jeopardy. Then on 2026-01-29 Butch emailed about two new Texas hires, including one in Corpus Christi territory, which made me worry even more that I might be replaced.
That sounds like the calendar email started a longer job-security worry, and the new-hire email intensified it.

In April, Cathy sent Ty to work with me so I could train him. I showed him the RBFCU protocol, contacts, emails, branch check-in, cleaning process, and signature routine. He ignored the process, caused issues with branch managers, and RBFCU escalated it. I went back to the locations, followed the normal process, apologized for anything outside our normal behavior, and got the work done. On 2026-04-24 Butch emailed that the company had parted ways with Ty because it was not a good fit. I took it as a sign I was doing the right thing and knew my job.
That reframed the fear: Ty looked threatening at first, but the RBFCU situation ended up confirming your process knowledge.
Today is 2026-05-03 and thinking about going back to work tomorrow is bringing all of this up again.
Why was thinking about work tomorrow bringing up old stress?
